title: Top 3 Claude Code Skills for Non-Designers
description:
Comment "designer" on my Instagram (link in the channel description) and I'll send you the links!

The biggest problem with vibe coding is that everything comes out flat and lifeless. These 3 Claude Code skills fix that.

First — Emil Kowalski's skill. One command and Claude starts adding real motion, proper easing, and animations that actually make sense.

Second — Impeccable. It gives Claude a full design vocabulary: 20 commands covering typography, color, spacing, and layout. My favorite is /polish — run it before shipping anything and Claude goes through your entire UI and tightens everything up.

Third — Taste Skill. It literally teaches Claude what good design looks like. No more generic gradients, no more Inter font on everything, no more AI-looking output. You get interfaces that look like a real designer touched them.

#claudecode #aitools #webdesign #ai #vibecoding
